subject: AWS Marketplace listing review — integration steps & product page copy
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing: integration matrix + first-pass product page

Hi team,

Looping you in on a new potential listing with Acme Analytics — Sarah from Acme is interested in a BYO-model offering plus a managed hosting option. They asked for our product page copy and a short integration matrix for the onboarding docs.

Attachments: acme-integration-matrix.xlsx (sheet: endpoints / auth / data-flow), product-page-draft-v3.docx (hero, bullets, pricing callouts)

Quick asks:
- Kim: can you review the product page doc for marketplace voice + procurement snippets? I want the CTA and trial language to be procurement-friendly.
- Olga: can you scan the integration matrix for anything that might trip AMPs (AMI/role-arn / entitlement)?
- Tessa: can you coordinate with Sarah for any missing legal footnotes (private offer, metered sku)?

Goal: have a consolidated set of copy + a one-page evidence checklist to hand to AWS by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Aditya
--
Aditya Rao
Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: integration matrix + first-pass product page

Thanks Aditya — reviewed the product-page-draft-v3.docx. High level notes:

- Hero: tighten the promise. Replace “fast inference” with “sub-200ms inference for common LLMs on hosted plan” — gives procurement a measurable SLO.
- Trial language: marketplace trials must avoid implying free tier + unlimited usage. Suggest “14-day trial with 10k tokens/month included” as an example + link to private offer options.
- Pricing snippet: call out metered vs. subscription clearly. Example line: “Metered: $0.002/token (estimated), Subscription: reserved capacity starting $X/month.”
- Compliance blurb: add short line: “SOC 2 Type II evidence available on request” — avoids uploading evidence into the listing itself.

Attachments I added comments to product-page-draft-v3.docx.

One procurement detail: AWS sometimes requires an entitlement mapping for private offers. Aditya/Olga — do we have a sku-to-entitlement mapping for BYO-model vs hosted? If not, we should draft one.

-Kim
--
Kimberly Park
Marketplaces & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: integration matrix + first-pass product page

Hi all,

I checked the acme-integration-matrix.xlsx. Quick technical flags:

- AMI / BYO path: Acme is planning to provide a model container. We need to confirm they support the GCR/OCI image signing we require for private offers. Action: Sarah to confirm image registry + signing.
- Role ARNs: the matrix references cross-account deploy roles; recommend adding a short example policy snippet (least-privilege) to the onboarding docs.
- Data handling: when offering “managed hosting” we must specify retention windows. For marketplace copy, suggest: “Data retention: configurable; default 30 days; contact Redwood for enterprise retention policies.”
- Entitlement mapping: I sketched a simple table; see newly attached aws-mp-checklist.pdf (page 2). It maps: BYO Image = entitlement BYO-IMAGE-001; Hosted-managed = sku HOSTED-BASE-001.

I’ll ping AWS support for the private offer SKU guidance in parallel.

-Olga
--
Olga Petrov
Solutions & Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Date: 2027-05-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: integration matrix + first-pass product page

Hi team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the comments. Quick answers and next steps from Acme: 

- Registry: we’ll use ECR and can sign images via our CI pipeline (Cosign). Confirmed.
- Retention: Acme is willing to default to 30 days for managed hosting and offer an enterprise option for 90/365. We need to know how that maps to the listing wording; happy to accept the suggested sentence.
- Entitlement/SKU: we’ll accept the proposed mapping names, please surface any naming constraints from AWS.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly — take your copy edits and produce a single-page marketplace blurb (200–280 characters hero + three bullets) for AWS metadata fields.
2) Olga — finalize the entitlement table and send to aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com with a note asking about naming constraints.
3) Tessa/Aditya — once the above are done, we’ll schedule a 30-minute call with Sarah (Acme) + AWS listing rep to validate the private offer metadata and evidence checklist.

We’ve attached a short internal Acme doc with product screenshots — not included in thread for sensitivity.

Thanks,
Sarah
--
Sarah Li
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Analytics
